nodes.description: Owner address of BotProtected/SHFL; set to tx.origin in SHFL constructor and used as sole guard on privileged functions such as delegate and list.
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract invoked with a raw low-level call from the checkBots modifier and from list.
Uniswap pair address derived by pairForUniswap and forwarded to the bot protection call.
Public balance ledger of the SHFL token; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and list.
Public allowance ledger; written in approve and decremented unchecked in transferFrom. Constructor grants uint(-1) allowances to router and to tx.origin.
Initial total supply of SHFL (1e26); used in unchecked arithmetic when allocating owner balance in list.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router interface used to add ETH liquidity in list.
Hardcoded WETH address used together with the token address to compute the Uniswap pair.
Private balance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Private nested allowance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Private total supply of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Modifier that performs an unguarded low-level staticcall-style external call to stopTheBots before executing the modified function body.
SHFL constructor: assigns owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer routine guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked allowance and balance bookkeeping before emitting Transfer.
Public payable approve that writes the caller's allowance mapping entry.
Owner-only function that delegatecalls an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, giving full storage/context control.
Internal pure helper that derives the Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 address computation.
Owner-only listing function: rewrites balances, adds ETH liquidity through the router, and calls the bot-protection contract while looping over recipient arrays.
Internal ERC20 transfer helper using SafeMath for balance updates.
Internal ERC20 approve helper writing the nested allowance mapping.
ERC20 transferFrom implementation using SafeMath to decrease allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, allowance spender root, approve owner and privilege gate everywhere.
Original transaction sender; used to set owner and granted unlimited allowance in the SHFL constructor.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used to compute the Uniswap addLiquidityETH deadline in list.
Low-level external call in the checkBots modifier executed before the modified function's state changes (reentrancy entry point).
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata inside delegate.
External payable call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with a timestamp-based deadline.
Low-level external call to the bot-protection contract at the end of list after balances have been rewritten.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (Solidity 0.7 has no built-in overflow checks).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic totalSupply * 6 / 100 used to set the owner balance in list.
_from parameter of the checkBots modifier, forwarded to the external bot check.
_to parameter of the checkBots modifier, forwarded to the external bot check.
_value parameter of the checkBots modifier, forwarded to the external bot check.
Constructor argument stored into stopTheBots.
Recipient argument of transfer.
Amount argument of transfer.
Source address argument of transferFrom.
Destination address argument of transferFrom.
Amount argument of transferFrom, used in all unchecked bookkeeping.
Spender argument of approve.
Allowance amount argument of approve.
Target address of the delegatecall in delegate.
Calldata of the delegatecall in delegate.
First token address for pair computation.
Second token address for pair computation.
Liquidity amount assigned to the contract balance in list.
Array of recipient addresses credited in list.
Array of amounts credited to the recipients in list.
Lower-sorted token address local inside pairForUniswap.
Higher-sorted token address local inside pairForUniswap.
Loop index over _tooWho/_amounts in list.
Success flag returned by the external bot-protection call in checkBots.
Raw return bytes of the external bot-protection call in checkBots.

edges.reason: Constructor argument _botProtection is supplied to the SHFL constructor, which forwards it to BotProtected.
Constructor argument is stored into the stopTheBots state variable that later acts as an external call target.
owner is assigned from tx.origin, so phishing a victim into a transaction silently transfers contract ownership.
The constructor uses tx.origin for authorization-relevant state initialisation.
Unlimited allowance is granted to tx.origin (and to the pair), letting the origin account drain the contract balance.
The checkBots modifier performs the low-level external call to stopTheBots.
stopTheBots is the target address of the low-level call.
The external call inside the checkBots modifier runs before transferFrom performs its balance/allowance updates, giving the callee control flow before effects.
msg.sender-derived _from value is encoded into the external bot-check calldata.
_from modifier parameter is ABI-encoded into the external call selector arguments.
_to modifier parameter is ABI-encoded into the external call selector arguments.
_value modifier parameter is ABI-encoded into the external call selector arguments.
Success boolean returned by the low-level call is captured in the notABot local.
Raw return data of the low-level call is captured in the isNotBot local.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
msg.sender is used as the source address when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
_to argument of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
_value argument of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch is taken and whose allowance is debited.
_from parameter selects the balance mapping entry that is debited.
_to parameter selects the balance mapping entry that is credited.
_value parameter is the amount moved and written into state.
allowance mapping is decremented in place without SafeMath in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping inside the unchecked subtraction.
_value is subtracted from the allowance using unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_from] is decremented in place without SafeMath in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance with unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_to] is incremented in place without SafeMath in transferFrom.
_value is added to the recipient balance with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom writes the allowance mapping.
msg.sender is the allowance owner when approve writes the mapping.
_spender parameter indexes the nested allowance mapping.
_value parameter is the allowance amount stored.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate enforces require(msg.sender == owner); the caller identity is the only authorization gate.
owner state variable is read in the delegate authorization check.
Because owner equals tx.origin, a phished owner transaction can be routed into delegate.
Parameter a flows into the delegatecall target.
Parameter b flows into the delegatecall calldata.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall operation.
Caller-supplied address becomes the delegatecall target, allowing arbitrary code execution in this contract's storage context.
Caller-supplied calldata is executed by the delegatecall.
tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed in pairForUniswap.
tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed in pairForUniswap.
Computed pair address is stored into uniPair.
pairForUniswap assigns the lower-sorted token address to token0.
pairForUniswap assigns the higher-sorted token address to token1.
_numList sets the token balance of the contract and the liquidity amount.
_tooWho array drives the recipient loop and the bot-protection call.
_amounts array provides the credited amounts in the loop.
list enforces require(msg.sender == owner) making the caller identity the authorization gate.
owner state variable is read in the list authorization check.
totalSupply is multiplied by 6 and divided by 100 with unchecked arithmetic.
The unchecked arithmetic expression is evaluated inside list.
routerForUniswap address is the target of the addLiquidityETH external call.
list performs the external addLiquidityETH call with msg.value.
The addLiquidityETH deadline is block.timestamp + 600, making the swap window miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is read inside list to build the router deadline.
stopTheBots is the target of the post-listing low-level call.
list makes a low-level external call after rewriting balances.
The external call to the bot-protection contract can re-enter list, which performs state changes before the interaction.
list iterates with loop index i over the recipient arrays.
Loop index indexes balanceOf and _amounts writes in list.
Loop bound is derived from _tooWho.length.
ERC20.transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates balance bookkeeping to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates allowance bookkeeping to _approve.
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
uniPair state variable is ABI-encoded into the bot-protection call inside checkBots.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only used as an argument of the bot-protection external call and should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
_to is only used as an argument of the bot-protection external call and should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
_value is only used as an argument of the bot-protection external call and should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
_botProtection is a constructor argument that is consumed entirely by the SHFL constructor.
_to is a transfer argument forwarded directly to transferFrom; fold into the transfer function node.
_value is a transfer argument forwarded directly to transferFrom; fold into the transfer function node.
_from is used only inside transferFrom to select the source balance; fold into the transferFrom function node.
_to is used only inside transferFrom to select the destination balance; fold into the transferFrom function node.
_value is used only inside transferFrom for the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
_spender is used only as the allowance index inside approve; fold into the approve function node.
_value is the allowance amount written only by approve; fold into the approve function node.
Address a is the target of the arbitrary delegatecall and belongs to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Calldata b is executed by the arbitrary delegatecall and belongs to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
tokenA is consumed only by the pair derivation helper; fold into pairForUniswap.
tokenB is consumed only by the pair derivation helper; fold into pairForUniswap.
_numList is used only inside list for balances and liquidity amount; fold into the list function node.
_tooWho drives the recipient loop of list; fold into the list function node.
_amounts provides the credited values in list; fold into the list function node.
token0 is a transient sort result local to pairForUniswap; fold into the pairForUniswap function node.
token1 is a transient sort result local to pairForUniswap; fold into the pairForUniswap function node.
Loop index i exists only to drive the recipient loop inside list.
notABot merely holds the success flag of the bot-protection external call; fold into that unsafe_operation node.
isNotBot merely holds the raw return bytes of the bot-protection external call; fold into that unsafe_operation node.
